local({
  mid <- c(250, 750, 1250, 1750, 2250, 2750, 3250, 3750, 4250, 4750)
  income <- mid[as.numeric(incomehouse)] / sqrt(as.numeric(houseperson))
  low <- stats::ave(income, wave, FUN = function(x) stats::quantile(x, 0.4, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE))
  high <- stats::ave(income, wave, FUN = function(x) stats::quantile(x, 0.6, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE))
  case_when(income <= low ~ "Low", income <= high ~ "Medium", income > high ~ "High", .default = "Unknown")
})

No income answer = Unknown. The release repeats the entry-interview answers at later waves and income was not asked again, so the 986 T3 rows of T1 entrants, about 24 months after that answer, are Unknown (12-month carry rule, blanked in the tidier); the T3 cut rests on the T2 and T3 entrants only (14 T3 rows keep an income answer).
